cat > programs/task-b2a42380.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]; frames=[]
 for color in range(1,10):
  todo={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color}
  while todo:
   comp={todo.pop()}; st=list(comp)
   while st:
    r,c=st.pop()
    for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
     if q in todo: todo.remove(q); comp.add(q); st.append(q)
   t=min(r for r,c in comp); b=max(r for r,c in comp); l=min(c for r,c in comp); rr=max(c for r,c in comp)
   if len(comp)>=8 and all(r in (t,b) or c in (l,rr) for r,c in comp): frames.append((color,t,b,l,rr))
  
 # scattered marker colors are the non-frame colors outside the outlines; their counts identify sets
 from collections import Counter
 framecolors={x[0] for x in frames}
 cnt=Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c] not in framecolors)
 marks=sorted(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
 frames.sort(key=lambda f:(f[1],f[3]))
 for i,(color,t,b,l,rr) in enumerate(frames):
  for r in range(t,b+1):
   for c in range(l,rr+1):
    if r in (t,b) or c in (l,rr): out[r][c]=color
  mark=marks[min(i,len(marks)-1)] if marks else 0
  for r in range(t+1,b):
   for c in range(l+1,rr):
    if (r-t-1+c-l-1)%2==0: out[r][c]=mark
 return out
PY
